SELECT c.id, c.recruit_id, c.name, c.gender, c.phone, c.email, c.education, c.school, c.work_years, c.source, c.expected_salary, c.stage, c.employee_id, c.remark, c.create_time, c.update_time, r.title AS recruit_title, r.recruit_no, e.emp_no, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_interview i WHERE i.candidate_id = c.id) AS interview_count, (SELECT i.result FROM hr_interview i WHERE i.candidate_id = c.id ORDER BY i.round DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_result FROM hr_candidate c JOIN hr_recruit r ON r.id = c.recruit_id LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = c.employee_id
c.recruit_id = #{recruitId} AND c.stage = #{stage}
AND (c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.school LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY c.id DESC
